assets.name: Aviary Gate
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Moticos matching-game cut-paper collage sprite, new bird-chain tier 4, called Aviary Gate (do not draw these words).
Input image is the approved tier 3 reference and exact visual style guide. Evolve this into a genuinely new authored silhouette while keeping its recognizable coral bird, cream belly, cream-and-mint map wing with a cobalt river and a coral dotted route, black beak/eye/feet, mustard-gold key, and dark teal fern.
Create one elegant airy garden gate: the large coral map-wing bird sits centrally on a horizontal gold key perch; above and around it, a broad open mustard arch grows into one asymmetric dark-teal fern trellis. The arch changes the silhouette into a tall open architectural form, but the bird remains the large dominant focal shape, about half the total object height. Preserve open transparent spaces within the arch. Simplify to a few large crisp paper shapes, recognizable at 50 px; 5–7 large fern leaves maximum on each side, not delicate ornament. Key bow is a clear gold circle at lower left and key teeth at lower right. Flat handcrafted layered cut-paper art, subtle natural paper grain, clean cut edges, very shallow paper overlap only. Same cream, coral-red, deep teal, mint, cobalt and mustard palette as reference.
Square isolated balanced composition with generous 10% clear margin on all sides. Genuine transparent alpha background, including openings. No background color, ground, shadow, container, border, badge, medallion, text, labels, numbers, extra birds, multiple tiles, photography, 3D or gradients. Deliver only this single new illustration.

Two bold dark-teal fern stems rise from the cup and curve inward into a tall asymmetrical open botanical canopy, their tips meeting high above in a graceful arch, with only 5–7 large leaves per stem.
